headline: Trump accuses Iran of driving up oil prices pre-midterms
dek: IRGC Navy: tracked and hit 4 vessels conducting ship-to-ship oil transfers in the northern Persian Gulf (called 'illegal route' violators warned earlier) — all four hit simultaneously and caught fire. Three other vessels struck mines west of the Strait of Hormuz overnight, were damaged/caught…
sources: IRGC Navy statement (via Sepah News and Mehr News, en.mehrnews.com); verbatim relay via Reuters chain and The Times
fault_line: Iran enforcing its closure or fabricating a blockade it can't enforce — is Hormuz really 'managed' by the IRGC while 82% of prewar oil still moves?
